jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Color

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "string",
  "enum": ["red", "green", "blue"]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/colorpkg

go 1.27
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

func TestColor_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	for _, want := range []string{"red", "green", "blue"} {
		var c Color
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"`+want+`"`), &c); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("Unmarshal(%q): %v", want, err)
			continue
		}
		if string(c) != want {
			t.Errorf("got %q, want %q", string(c), want)
		}
	}
}

// enum is a validation concern enforced by jsonschema.Validate, not
// the generated unmarshaler. A value outside the enum decodes
// structurally without error.
func TestColor_NoEnumValidation(t *testing.T) {
	var c Color
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"yellow"`), &c); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(c) != "yellow" {
		t.Errorf("got %q, want %q", string(c), "yellow")
	}
}
